appName: I Am Bad Dog From Hell
displayName: I Am Bad Dog From Hell
display_name: I Am Bad Dog From Hell
display_long_description:
In I Am Bad Dog From Hell , you’re not just any dog—you’re a chaos-fueled prankster straight from the depths of canine mischief! Experience the mayhem in full VR from your own dog’s-eye view as you torment your cranky, relentless grandpa. Sneak into rooms to pop balloons, toss books from shelves, and flick the TV on just to watch him fume. Snatch a frying pan and hurl it his way, bound onto tables, or even cling to the ceiling to stay out of reach. Every prank is a new way to drive him mad while you make daring escapes from his grasp. But beware—grandpa’s fast, clever, and determined to catch you! Packed with slapstick humor, fast-paced action, and hilarious interactions, this is a heart-racing dog vs human showdown where the goal is simple: be the baddest dog and never get caught.

Features:

Full VR Dog’s-Eye View – Immerse yourself in the chaos from a first-person canine perspective.

Mischief-Packed Gameplay – Pop balloons, throw books, mess with the TV, and more.

Dynamic Grandpa AI – Outsmart a relentless and reactive grandpa determined to catch you.

Interactive Environment – Grab, toss, and jump onto objects, from frying pans to shelves.

High Mobility – Run, leap, and even cling to ceilings to stay one step ahead.

Slapstick Fun – Enjoy over-the-top pranks and hilarious reactions in every encounter.
